text:
annika: quick check — can we enable per-customer flag `contract_v2` for tenant:acme? contract starts tomorrow, want a guarded rollout (allowlist + small canary). who can flip?

samir: @annika I can do the flip. do we want a tenant-scoped override or a global flag with tenant slice?

kevin: it's a tenant override. config lives in ff-service -> tenant_overrides. snippet: ```tenant_overrides: { "acme": { enabled: true, rollout: 100 } }``` we'll want an initial small canary (10%) then ramp.

maria: ACME is enterprise/VIP — route them to dedicated pool. also add contract_gating flag and annotate the contract id in the override.

annika: checklist for roll: 1) add allowlist entry for acme admins 2) set rollout=10% for 1h canary 3) monitor p99 latency, error_rate, and model-quality evals 4) have rollback command + owner (samir) 5) notify ACME CSM.

samir: creating PR now and will ping for quick review. @kevin can you add canary policy in the console?

kevin: adding canary policy. proposed config: audience: tenant_acme, rollout: 10%, duration: 60m, metrics: [latency_p99 <= 250ms, error_rate <= 0.5%], fallback_model: small-variant. will attach to the flag.

maria: also ensure logs go to acme-telemetry prefix and alerts to acme-sre channel. add annotation to the PR describing escalation path.

annika: PR link: https://git.internal/pr/6421 — includes tenant override + allowlist change. ci checks should run.

ci-bot: build passed ✅ tests: flag-service unit/integration ok.

samir: PTAL @kevin @maria — plan is to merge at 16:00 PT and flip to 10% at 16:05. I'll be the toggle owner.

kevin: LGTM. I'll apply the canary policy at 16:05. rollback command (if needed): ```curl -XPOST https://api.redwood.internal/flags/tenant/acme/rollback -d '{"flag":"contract_v2"}'``` keep small-variant fallback ready.

maria: I'll be on-standby 16:00-17:30 and will set alert thresholds. escalate to platform-oncall if error_rate > 0.5% or latency_p99 spikes 2x baseline. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: toggled contract_v2 -> 10% for tenant acme at 16:05 by samir.

annika: watching metrics now — no spike, quality evals look stable. if all good, ramp plan to 100% after 45m.

samir: ramped to 100% at 16:55. closing the loop — PR merged and annotation added. thanks everyone.

deploy-bot: confirmed contract_v2 -> 100% for tenant acme at 16:55 by samir.

annika: noted. will follow up with CSM and add post-rollout note in #customer-updates. :white_check_mark:
